name: SRIDGE
recent: Silver Ridge Holdings 在2026年10月获 Bursa Securities 批准最多 43,943,082 股私募新股上市，并于11月完成 ESOS 新股发行。公司将于12月11日召开第21届常年股东大会，同时有多名董事及大股东在闭门期前后申报持股变动。最新财报（2026年6月30日止）营收同比大增但转为净亏损。
notable: Bursa Securities 批准公司最多 43,943,082 股私募新股在 ACE Market 上市。
公司将于2026年12月11日召开第21届常年股东大会。
risks: 943,082 股新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
独立董事 Dr Ong Chin Yee 于2026年9月18日逝世。
最新季度净亏损 1,353,000 令吉，净利率为 -8.9%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 15,175,000 令吉，同比增 162.9%，但环比降 25.4%；净亏损 1,353,000 令吉，净利率 -8.9%，而上一季度净利率为 2.5%。

recent_en: Silver Ridge Holdings obtained Bursa Securities approval in October 2026 for the listing of up to 43,943,082 private placement shares, and completed ESOS share issuances in November. The latest financial period ended 30 June 2026 showed strong year-on-year revenue growth but a swing to net loss.
notable_en: Bursa Securities approved the listing of up to 43,943,082 private placement shares on the ACE Market.
The company proposed a change of name to TANGERINE HOLDINGS BHD.
risks_en: The proposed private placement of up to 43,943,082 new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Independent director Dr Ong Chin Yee passed away on 18 September 2026.
The latest quarter recorded a net loss of MYR 1,353,000, with a net margin of -8.9%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 15,175,000, up 162.9% year-on-year but down 25.4% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was MYR 1,353,000 with a net margin of -8.9%, compared with a net margin of 2.5% in the previous quarter.
